snippet.title: Announcement Teaser NEX EVO
snippet.description:
NEX EVO — Official Gameplay Teaser | Wishlist on Steam


NEX EVO is a high-speed, atmospheric sci-fi action platformer featuring bio-mechanical mobility, tether mechanics, and visceral combat.

ABOUT THE GAME
Navigate dark industrial environments, master high-momentum grappling traversal, and survive aggressive organic threats in this dark sci-fi action title.

KEY FEATURES

Fluid Bio-Mobility: Swing, tether, and vault across vertical industrial structures.

Visceral Combat: Face off against relentless organic and mechanical threats.

Atmospheric World: Explore dark, rain-slicked sci-fi environments illuminated by biomechanical luminescence.

NOTE: Gameplay shown in this trailer reflects an early pre-Alpha build and is in active development. Visuals, mechanics, and performance are subject to change.
#nexevo #indiegame #gaming #trailer #fps
